title: gnssguard: GNSS interference detection from open ADS-B data
description:
Detects GPS jamming and spoofing that affects aircraft from free, open ADS-B flight data (adsb.lol), in 1-degree cells and 15-minute windows, and publishes a nightly map and open data files: https://sahilprg.github.io/gnss-interference/

Every evaluation is declared in docs/evaluation_protocol.md before it is run, and all published results are regenerated by gnssguard benchmark into results/, with the model hash and the hash of every input.

Version 0.2.0 is archived before the sealed test. It fixes the model (hash 81062b5eb365, trained 29 Sep-24 Oct 2026), the hand labels, the integrity-only baseline and the six sealed-test questions before the test sample (5-18 Nov 2026) is drawn on or after 19 Nov 2026. See CHANGELOG.md.

Research project. Not for navigation or operational decisions. Code: MIT. Derived data: ODbL 1.0 (DATA_LICENSE.md).
notes: Input data: adsb.lol open data archive (ODbL 1.0). Map background: Natural Earth (public domain).
